_comment: Shared drip parity cases. Run by src/utils/drip-conditions/dripParity.test.ts (vitest) and ai_service/tests/test_course_knowledge_drip_parity.py (pytest). Anchors and now are at 12:00 UTC so results are the same in UTC and Asia/Kolkata; unlock_time values avoid the 12:00-17:30 window. message: exact text (null = no message); message_regex: pattern for locale-formatted dates. Change both evaluators together.
